name: hero-city-reference-ui
description: Verify current Hero City HUD crops, uploaded Shop and Inventory actions, live Shop and Inventory art contracts, and the two-sided world shop sign.

steps.label: wait for supplied Hero City art

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local root=workspace:WaitForChild('PunchWallRPG') local sign=root:WaitForChild('Fist Shop Sign') local frontId='rbxassetid://104014193600358' local backId='rbxassetid://111791716595528' local surfaces,decals=0,0 local frontDecal,backDecal,frontImage,backImage,frontCopy,backCopy=false,false,false,false,false,false for _,d in ipairs(sign:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA('Decal') and d.Name=='Hero City Artwork Decal' then decals+=1 if d.Face==Enum.NormalId.Front and d.Texture==frontId then frontDecal=true elseif d.Face==Enum.NormalId.Back and d.Texture==backId then backDecal=true end elseif d:IsA('SurfaceGui') and d.Name=='Generated Graphic' then surfaces+=1 local image=d:FindFirstChild('Hero City Artwork') local expectedId=d.Face==Enum.NormalId.Front and frontId or d.Face==Enum.NormalId.Back and backId or '' if image and image:IsA('ImageLabel') and image.Image==expectedId then if d.Face==Enum.NormalId.Front then frontImage=true elseif d.Face==Enum.NormalId.Back then backImage=true end end local hasTitle,hasSubtitle=false,false for _,label in ipairs(d:GetDescendants()) do if label:IsA('TextLabel') then if d.Face==Enum.NormalId.Front and label.Text=='HERO FIST HQ' then hasTitle=true elseif d.Face==Enum.NormalId.Front and label.Text=='CHOOSE | EQUIP | POWER UP' then hasSubtitle=true elseif d.Face==Enum.NormalId.Back and label.Text=='SMASH!' then hasTitle=true elseif d.Face==Enum.NormalId.Back and label.Text=='HERO CITY' then hasSubtitle=true end end end if d.Face==Enum.NormalId.Front then frontCopy=hasTitle and hasSubtitle elseif d.Face==Enum.NormalId.Back then backCopy=hasTitle and hasSubtitle end end end local frontArt=frontDecal and frontImage local backArt=backDecal and backImage local worldSign=sign.Parent==root and sign.Anchored and sign.Size==Vector3.new(36,10,.8) and surfaces==2 and decals==2 and frontArt and backArt and frontCopy and backCopy return H:JSONEncode({worldSign=worldSign,surfaces=surfaces,decals=decals,frontArt=frontArt,backArt=backArt,frontCopy=frontCopy,backCopy=backCopy})

steps.label: current two-sided world shop sign uses approved art and copy

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui:WaitForChild('PunchWallHUD') local a=g:WaitForChild('PunchWallClientAutomation') local r=g:WaitForChild('PixelPerfectHeroCityHUD') local atlasId='rbxassetid://104014193600358' local function read(parent,name) local d=parent and parent:FindFirstChild(name,true) return d and string.format('%d,%d,%d,%d',d.ImageRectOffset.X,d.ImageRectOffset.Y,d.ImageRectSize.X,d.ImageRectSize.Y) or '' end local old,current=0,0 for _,d in ipairs(g:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA('ImageLabel') then if d.Image=='rbxassetid://134314320646796' then old+=1 elseif d.Image==atlasId then current+=1 end end end local shopButton=r:WaitForChild('ShopButton') local inventoryButton=r:WaitForChild('InventoryButton') local actionArt=shopButton.Image=='rbxassetid://104281527974467' and inventoryButton.Image=='rbxassetid://123409223461276' and inventoryButton:GetAttribute('ToolAction')=='OpenInventory' and inventoryButton:GetAttribute('MenuRow')=='Shop' a:Invoke('OpenTab','Fists') task.wait(.4) local shop=g.GameMenu:WaitForChild('FunctionalHeroShop') local shopCards,shopArt,shopPresentations,shopChrome=0,0,0,0 for _,card in ipairs(shop:GetChildren()) do if card:IsA('Frame') and card.Name:match('ShopCard$') then shopCards+=1 local tier=tonumber(card:GetAttribute('ShopFistTier')) or 0 local art=card:FindFirstChild('ProductArt') local chrome=card:FindFirstChild('HeroGauntletTierChrome') local partCount=tonumber(card:GetAttribute('StaticPreviewPartCount')) or 0 local artOk=art and art:IsA('ImageLabel') and art.Image~='' and art.ImageColor3==Color3.new(1,1,1) and art.ImageTransparency==0 and art:GetAttribute('LoadedArtUnobscured')==true and art:GetAttribute('HeroGauntletArtVariant')==card:GetAttribute('ShopFistArtVariant') and art:GetAttribute('HeroGauntletTier')==tier if artOk then shopArt+=1 end local presentationOk=card:GetAttribute('ShopFistPresentation')=='HeroGauntletV2StaticChrome' and card:GetAttribute('StaticPreviewRenderLoop')==false and card:GetAttribute('StaticPreviewChromeOnly')==true and card:GetAttribute('StaticPreviewChromeCoverage')=='PerimeterOnlyV1' and partCount==tier+1 and partCount>=2 and partCount<=6 if presentationOk then shopPresentations+=1 end local chromeOk=chrome and chrome:IsA('Frame') and chrome.Active==false and chrome.Selectable==false and chrome:FindFirstChild('StaticTierOutline')~=nil and chrome:FindFirstChild('StaticTierRail')~=nil and card:FindFirstChild('HeroGauntletV2StaticSilhouette')==nil if chromeOk then shopChrome+=1 end end end a:Invoke('OpenInventory') task.wait(.4) local inventory=g.GameMenu:WaitForChild('FunctionalInventory') local inventoryTitle=inventory:FindFirstChild('InventoryTitle',true) local inventoryArt=inventory.Visible and inventory:GetAttribute('ArtMode')=='ReferenceNativeV3' and inventory:GetAttribute('ChromeAssetMode')=='Native' and inventory:GetAttribute('ItemArtFallback')=='NativeFallback' and inventoryTitle and inventoryTitle.Text=='INVENTORY' and inventory:FindFirstChild('InventoryWindow',true)~=nil and inventory:FindFirstChild('InventoryHeader',true)~=nil a:Invoke('CloseMenus') return H:JSONEncode({currentEnough=current>=20,old=old,actionArt=actionArt,shopIcon=shopButton.Image,inventoryIcon=inventoryButton.Image,shopCards=shopCards,shopArt=shopArt,shopPresentations=shopPresentations,shopChrome=shopChrome,inventoryArt=inventoryArt,inventoryMode=inventory:GetAttribute('ArtMode'),inventoryChrome=inventory:GetAttribute('ChromeAssetMode'),power=read(g.StatsPanel:FindFirstChild('Power',true),'StatIcon'),punch=read(g.MobileControls.ActionPunch,'ActionIcon'),train=read(g.MobileControls.ActionTrain,'ActionIcon'),settings=read(g.GameMenu.Tabs.SettingsTab,'TabIcon')})

steps.label: current HUD Shop Inventory and live product art contracts are active
